preview_method: Existing RGB sheet pixels cropped and proportionally resized with nearest-neighbor. No regenerated artwork.
preview_limitation: Opaque source backdrop and overlapping ground shadow remain. This is a design/height comparison, not a finished transparent game sprite.
rejected_reason: The built-in tool reinterpreted existing pixel shapes despite a background-only request; not accepted as a faithful extraction.
style_constraints: Preserve existing race face, head/body proportions and pose
Preserve eye size, pupils, ears, muzzle and fangs
Keep strong stepped outlines and broad pixel color blocks
Use existing sheet art directly wherever available
Match each original native sprite visible height with proportional width
